allowed_outputs: valid p1 wall-clock coverage by market
valid price-stationary nonzero imbalance transition count
markets with at least 25 valid transitions

authoritative_replay_sources.normalized_stream_role: lineage and deterministic cross-check only; not authoritative state source

deterministic_replay.method: Replay the frozen authoritative inputs twice from pristine state using identical code and compare canonical engineering summary, transition identities, coverage intervals, generation history, and final reconstructed token states.

forbidden_outputs: future midpoint change after an H6 transition
correlation between imbalance change and future price
regression of future price on imbalance change

primary_transition_definition.eligibility_window: registered game_start_time_utc - 1800 seconds <= raw frame receive time < registered game_start_time_utc
primary_transition_definition.unit: at most one p1 transition per received raw websocket frame
primary_transition_definition.venue_tob_mismatch_rule: If the collector identifies a venue/local top-of-book mismatch from a raw frame, that token/frame is ineligible as a primary transition. Continuity resumes only from the subsequent authoritative REST resync generation.

purpose: One-time engineering/reconstruction feasibility validation of the frozen H6-M1 capture. No H6 future response, predictive effect, economic edge, winner, settlement, or PnL may be calculated.

reconciliation_interval_gate.measurement: wall-clock interval between periodic reconciliation completions during active capture, including initialization-to-first and last-reconciliation-to-final-game-start edge intervals

replay_ordering.rest_batch_rule: Rows sharing connection_id, reason, request_started_at_utc and response_received_at_utc form one authoritative REST batch.

state_reconstruction.initial_state: uninitialized and invalid until authoritative full snapshot
state_reconstruction.price_change_size_semantics: absolute current aggregated size at price level
state_reconstruction.rest_reconciliation_mismatch: increments generation and establishes a new authoritative state
state_reconstruction.rest_resync: increments generation and establishes a new authoritative state
state_reconstruction.stale_ws_rule: state-mutating WS events with venue timestamp strictly older than last authoritative venue timestamp are preserved but not applied
state_reconstruction.ws_full_book: authoritative within-stream full snapshot; does not increment generation while current state is valid, but restoration of invalid/uninitialized state creates a new generation

success_gates.raw_text_frame_capture: all received text frames preserved with valid SHA256

verdict_logic.FAIL_ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY: Any integrity, causality, reconstruction, raw-frame, deterministic replay, initial-snapshot, mixing, future-backfill, in-play contamination, reconciliation-interval, or valid-state coverage gate fails.
verdict_logic.INCONCLUSIVE_ENGINEERING: All integrity, causality, reconstruction, and >=95% coverage gates pass, but one or more frozen transition-density/breadth gates are not met.
verdict_logic.PASS_ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY: All frozen integrity, causality, reconstruction, coverage, transition-density, and market-breadth gates pass.

wall_clock_coverage.denominator: 5 registered markets * 1800 scheduled p1 pregame seconds
wall_clock_coverage.interpretation: A mismatch creates a continuity/generation boundary at the authoritative reconciliation response time. The validator does not retroactively declare the preceding interval invalid because no such backdating rule was preregistered.
wall_clock_coverage.numerator: wall-clock seconds during the scheduled windows for which the causally reconstructed p1 state satisfies the frozen valid-state definition
wall_clock_coverage.per_market_coverage: report for diagnostics only; no additional per-market 95% pass requirement
